insert:
SEGMENTATION_BACKEND="${FLYCO_SEGMENTATION_BACKEND:-native}"
SEGMENTATION_ENDPOINT="${FLYCO_SEGMENTATION_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:8820}"

--segmentation-backend native|A|D
                          Select the original provider or the HTTP A/D adapter.
  --segmentation-endpoint URL
                          Reachable A/D model service URL (default port 8820).

--segmentation-backend) SEGMENTATION_BACKEND="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --segmentation-endpoint) SEGMENTATION_ENDPOINT="$2"; shift 2 ;;

case "$SEGMENTATION_BACKEND" in native|A|D) ;; *) echo "Invalid segmentation backend: $SEGMENTATION_BACKEND" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
if [[ "$SEGMENTATION_ENDPOINT" != http://* && "$SEGMENTATION_ENDPOINT" != https://* ]]; then
  echo "Segmentation endpoint must be an HTTP(S) URL." >&2
  exit 2
fi
PERCEPTION_CMD="$PERCEPTION_CMD segmentation_backend:=$SEGMENTATION_BACKEND segmentation_endpoint:=$(printf '%q' "$SEGMENTATION_ENDPOINT")"
